name: @tabai/app
description: Dashboard. Every read-only route resolves without a wallet connection.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.json tsconfig.ui.json tsconfig.custom-ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.next.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json tsconfig.ui.json tsconfig.custom-ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.next.json
scripts.test: tsc -b tsconfig.json tsconfig.ui.json tsconfig.custom-ui.json && node --test test/theme.test.mjs test/ui.test.mjs test/motion.test.mjs && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.test.json node --import tsx --test test/custom-ui.test.ts test/dashboard.test.ts test/dashboard-surfaces.test.ts test/registration.test.ts test/passkey.test.ts test/deployments.test.ts test/network-selection.test.ts
